name: 19120 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19120 (Philadelphia) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19120 (Philadelphia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19120 (Philadelphia) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: No religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
